instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The project uses `.js` and `.jsx` extensions. Do NOT create `.tsx` files.
Install Google Fonts 'Plus Jakarta Sans' and 'Cabinet Grotesk' via Google Fonts / Fontshare links in index.html.
Install and use `lucide-react` for high-end premium outline icons.
Install `framer-motion` for fluid animations (e.g., entrance animations, floating bubbles).

Landing Hero: Implement a split layout. Left side: High-contrast value prop, trust badges. Right side: The 3D phone image floating (`animate-[float_6s_ease-in-out_infinite]`). Around the phone, position Absolute small glowing Glassmorphism chips containing 'XOF' and 'XAF' and security lock icons.
Hero Background: Place the `world_map_bg` absolute, inset-0, `opacity-5`, behind all content to create depth without distraction.
Features Section: Use a 3-column Bento Grid structure. Each card must have generous padding (`p-8`), `rounded-[24px]`, and a prominent blue icon.
Payment Carousel: Implement an infinite auto-scrolling marquee (`react-fast-marquee`) with grayscale logos that colorize on hover.
Stats Section: Must have a deep blue background (`bg-blue-600`), large typography (`text-5xl`), and small avatar clusters next to the '50K+ users' stat.

Registration Page: Make the 'Personal/Merchant' account type toggle look like a premium segmented control (using standard div layout and active state classes). Add a 'visual only' Recaptcha styled box.
Dashboard Navigation: Fixed 64-width sidebar, sticky topbar with glassmorphism `bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md`.

Dashboard Balances: Implement two large cards (XOF, XAF). They MUST use the `gradients.bluePremium` gradient and `rounded-[24px]` with crisp white text. Add a faint absolute positioned icon or pattern inside them for depth.
Dashboard Quick Actions: Create a row of 4 actions (Transfer, Deposit, Link, Exchange). Use pastel blue `bg-blue-50` rounded squares (`rounded-[20px]`) that turn solid blue on hover.
DO NOT use a fully transparent header. The sticky header over the landing page must use `backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80`.
DO NOT use `Inter` for headings. Ensure `font-cabinet` is applied to all Headings.
Add `data-testid` attributes to EVERY interactive element (buttons, links, form inputs, toggles). E.g., `data-testid="login-btn"`.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text inside the blue gradient balance cards is pure white or very light blue to pass APCA contrast checks.
accessibility.focus: All focus states should use `focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-600 focus:ring-offset-2 outline-none`.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use optical alignment and asymmetric bento grids where appropriate.
Create depth through layered design elements (shadows, overlaps, floating bubbles).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
NEVER use emojis like 🤖🧠💭 for icons. Use lucide-react.
Never use generic placeholder text or empty dummy images. Always use provided assets or build stylized CSS components.
